From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>

Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>

Subject: Rerank model fit validation — Acme / follow-up + next steps

Hi Alex,

Thanks again for the time today — really useful call. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

- Recap: We reviewed your current candidate generation + scoring pipeline and the goal to improve top-k relevance for product search (focus on NDCG@10 & MRR for merchandising-critical queries).
- Initial recommendation: run a small validation of our recommended rerank variants (redwood-rerank-v2, redwood-rerank-quant) on your 5k prompt set to measure NDCG / MRR delta and check latency/cost tradeoffs.
- Risks you flagged: prompt sensitivity for long queries and potential quality regressions for tail intents — we'll include specific prompt slice evaluations.

Proposed next steps: 
1) You share a sanitized sample (5k rows) — we suggested the prompt_set_v2.csv format (example attached in our template).
2) We run the validation and return a short NDCG/MRR report + suggested A/B plan (approx 48–72 hours).
3) If the metrics look good, schedule a canary A/B in your staging environment (we can coordinate traffic split and rollout windows).

Attached: sample prompt_set_v2.csv template and a short checklist for sanitized exports. If you prefer, Neha can pick up the data ingestion piece and coordinate S3 transfer.

Next available times to sync: Tue 9–11am PT or Wed 2–4pm PT — let me know what works.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai
redwood.ai

Attachments: prompt_set_v2.csv (template), data-export-checklist.md

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@acme.com>
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Rerank model fit validation — Acme / initial validation results

Hi team — quick update after running the 5k validation on the sample Priya sent this morning (thanks for the quick turn). Summary below; full report attached.

Highlights (redwood-rerank-v2 vs baseline):
- NDCG@10: +7.1% absolute (baseline 0.612 -> 0.683)
- MRR: +9.3% relative
- p95 latency (per-request, rerank only): 42ms with redwood-rerank-v2 (quantized variant ~28ms; tradeoff: small drop in NDCG ~0.8% vs non-quant)

Quality notes:
- Tail intents (long, multi-clause queries) show intermittent regressions for the quantized variant — we included a slice report ("tail_queries.csv") showing examples.
- Prompt sensitivity: certain prefix formulations (merchant-specific tokens) led to inconsistent rerank ordering; we recommend adding 1–2 prompt normalization rules in preprocessing.

AB plan suggestion (attached ab_test_plan.md):
- Canary: 5% traffic for 7 days in staging; metric guardrails: NDCG@10 delta >= +5% and no significant drop in click-through for curated top-k.
- Rollout: linear ramp to 50% over 2 weeks if metrics are stable.

Attachments: acme_rerank_ndcg_mrr_report.pdf (full metrics + graphs), prompt_set_v2.csv (annotated with eval columns), ab_test_plan.md

Let me know if you want a short 30-min review where I walk through the PDF and show the failing tail examples. We should also align on the exact traffic slices and any safety/merchandising overrides Acme requires.

Thanks,

Rishi Malhotra
Applied ML Engineer | Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.ai

Alex / Priya — great results, and thanks for the fast sample. Quick proposed cadence based on Rishi's findings: 

1) Short review: 30-min sync to walk through the acme_rerank_ndcg_mrr_report.pdf and the failing tail examples — proposed Wed 10am PT. Rishi will drive.
2) Tune: we will ship two small pre-processing rules to address prompt normalization (non-invasive) and re-run the quantized variant on the tail slice — expect 48 hours.
3) Canary: if the tuned quantized variant recovers tail perf within the guardrail, proceed with the AB plan (5% for 7 days).

- Acme: confirm Wed 10am PT (Alex/Priya) and approve canary window.
- Redwood (Rishi + Neha): deliver tuned prompt normalization and rerun quantized validation (48h) + share updated report.
- Marissa: coordinate the canary schedule and prepare the short rollout checklist for your infra team.
